info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Sale Product Expert Sales Support-spec
info.description: The Expert Sales Support Product Creation API enables businesses to generate tailored sales products efficiently. This endpoint facilitates the submission of detailed product specifications, empowering sales teams to provide personalized support. Typical consumers include sales representatives and product managers who require streamlined processes for rapid product deployment in the banking sector. Utilize this API to enhance customer engagement through focused sales strategies while ensuring optimal product alignment with market needs.

post.summary: Request expert sales support for a product.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to request support from an expert for a specific product. It is designed to help customers get detailed assistance and guidance regarding product features, pricing, and availability. As part of the sales support process, the expertise provided will directly address customer inquiries and enhance the overall sales experience.
